headline: Alkali Metals submits AGM minutes to exchanges
hook: Procedural filing on annual general meeting
summary: Alkali Metals Limited has submitted the official minutes of its Annual General Meeting held on August 21, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a standard corporate compliance filing documenting shareholder approvals and discussions during the meeting. Indian retail investors tracking the company can review the published minutes for formal records of resolutions passed. The filing contains no new operational or financial surprises.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate financial impact.
